# Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root: it is the single source of instructions for AI agents on Trading Agent Mpu Gandring (setup protocol, CLI/office parity, safety rules). Start in PAPER, give one direct link per step, keep keys in `.env` or a secret store and never in chat, refuse main wallet keys, seed phrases and withdraw-enabled keys, run `npm run doctor`, confirm exchange-side stops, and never loosen a guard.
